lines.en: label makotowinterbeach1:
I tap on Makoto’s name in my phone and wait for her to answer.
lines.zh: 我在手机上点下 Makoto 的名字，等她接听。

lines.en: It’s been a little while since she asked me if I’d accompany her to the beach and...what better time to do that than a random afternoon in the middle of winter?
lines.zh: 她问我要不要陪她去海边，已经过去一阵子了……而还有什么时机，比隆冬里一个随随便便的下午更合适呢？

lines.en: Yes, the idea of the two of us going {i}there{/i} when it’s obvious she just wants to be alone with me rather than scope out a venue she’s already familiar with is a little...abnormal.
lines.zh: 是啊，明明一看就知道她只是想跟我独处，而不是去考察一个她早就熟得不能再熟的地方，我们俩却要跑{i}一趟{/i}，这想法确实有点……不正常。

lines.en: But I’m not going to throw away a vacation opportunity with a cute girl just because the conditions aren’t perfect.
lines.zh: 但我不会因为条件不够完美，就扔掉一个和可爱女孩度假的机会。

lines.en: Besides, I’m sure we’ll find some way to keep warm in no time at all...
lines.zh: 再说了，我确信我们很快就能找到取暖的办法……

lines.en: I'm talking about sex.
lines.zh: 我说的是做爱。

lines.en: That was a sex joke.
lines.zh: 那是个黄色笑话。

lines.en: : Hello?
: Hey, Makoto. What are you up to right now?
lines.zh: : 嘿，Makoto。你现在在忙什么？

lines.en: : Right now? I’m just...hanging around. Why do you ask?
lines.zh: : 现在？我只是……随便待着。你为什么问这个？

lines.en: : Is now a good time to go on that beach trip?
lines.zh: : 现在去海边那趟旅行合适吗？

lines.en: : Uhh...no. Not really.
lines.zh: : 呃……不。其实不太合适。

lines.en: : Can you hold on one second, please?
lines.zh: : 能请你稍等一下吗？

lines.en: : Huh? Uhh, yeah. I guess that’s fine.
lines.zh: : 啊？呃，行。应该没问题。

lines.en: : Thanks. I’ll be back in a second.
lines.zh: : 谢谢。我马上回来。

lines.en: I hear Makoto put the phone down and start talking to someone (Probably her mom) about something I can’t really make out over the sound of a television in the background.
lines.zh: 我听见 Makoto 把电话放下，开始跟某个人（大概是她妈）说着什么，背景里电视的声音让我听不太清。

lines.en: I remain on the line for several minutes and begin to lose my patience.
lines.zh: 我在电话这头等了好几分钟，开始失去耐心。

lines.en: But just as I’m about to hang up and find something else to do, I hear her coming back.
lines.zh: 但就在我准备挂断、去找点别的事做时，我听见她回来了。

lines.en: : Yeah. We can go now. But...I want to meet {i}there{/i} if that’s okay.
lines.zh: : 嗯。我们现在可以走了。不过……我想在{i}那儿{/i}碰面，可以吗？

lines.en: : Why?
lines.zh: : 为什么？

lines.en: : If this is about you throwing me a surprise party, I don’t want one.
lines.zh: : 如果这是为了给我办惊喜派对，那我可不要。

lines.en: : Why on earth would I throw you a surprise party? That’s obviously not what’s happening.
lines.zh: : 我到底为什么要给你办惊喜派对？显然不是那么回事。

lines.en: : Well then what is it exactly?
lines.zh: : 那到底是什么事？

lines.en: : That...will probably be easier to explain once we’re there.
lines.zh: : 那个……等我们到了那儿大概更好解释。

lines.en: : It’s already starting to get late, though. So if we’re doing this, get ready now and meet me at the beach in one hour.
lines.zh: : 不过天已经开始晚了。所以要干就现在准备，一小时后海边见。

lines.en: : Okay?
lines.zh: : 好吗？

lines.en: : ...Yeah.
: I’ll see you there.
lines.zh: : 那儿见。

lines.en: I hang up the phone and begin to gather a few of my things to prepare for an overnight trip full of debauchery and...probably smart people stuff.
lines.zh: 我挂了电话，开始收拾几样东西，为一场充满放荡、还有……大概是聪明人才会干的事的过夜旅行做准备。

lines.en: I don’t know. Makoto will probably want to take a break between orgasms to brush up on encyclopedic knowledge or something like that.
lines.zh: 我也不知道。Makoto 大概会想在两次高潮之间休息一下，顺便温习点百科知识什么的。

lines.en: scene wintersky
I send Ami a message telling her I won’t be around tonight and then promptly turn my phone off to avoid the barrage of messages she is sure to send me in response.
lines.zh: 我给 Ami 发了条消息，说今晚我不在，然后立刻关掉手机，免得被她肯定会发来的一连串回复轰炸。

lines.en: But it’s better off that she doesn’t know where I’ll be.
lines.zh: 不过她不知道我在哪儿反倒更好。

lines.en: Especially since I’m going to be there with one of her least favorite people in the entire world.
lines.zh: 尤其是我要和她在全世界最不喜欢的人之一待在一起。

lines.en: But hey, that’s just how things are sometimes. And I don’t really want to think about it right now.
lines.zh: 不过嘿，有时候就是这么回事。而且我现在真不想去想它。

lines.en: I just want to make it to the inn, kick my shoes off, and ruthlessly plow my class rep until she can no longer walk.
lines.zh: 我只想赶到旅馆，把鞋踢掉，然后毫不留情地把我的班长干到走不动路为止。

lines.en: This is going to be a good weekend.
lines.zh: 这会是个美好的周末。

lines.en: scene makotobeachintro1
I make it to the beach in just under an hour to find Makoto waiting near the spot where we set up camp for our last class trip.
lines.zh: 不到一小时我就到了海边，发现 Makoto 正在上次班级旅行扎营的地方附近等着。

lines.en: if mayadorm35 == True:
A barrage of memories (The kind I won’t black out for remembering) come rushing back into my head, likely avoiding a collision with Makoto’s.
lines.zh: 一连串记忆（那种我回想起来不会昏过去的）涌回我的脑海，大概刚好避开了与 Makoto 的记忆相撞。

lines.en: else:
A barrage of memories come rushing back into my head, likely avoiding a collision with Makoto’s.
lines.zh: 一连串记忆涌回我的脑海，大概刚好避开了与 Makoto 的记忆相撞。

lines.en: Probably, at least.
lines.zh: 大概吧，至少。

lines.en: I’m not really sure how her brain would rationalize the thought of an earlier class trip when this is still her first[school] year with me as her teacher.
lines.zh: 我不太确定她的大脑会怎么合理化「更早的一次班级旅行」这个念头，毕竟这还是她有我做老师的第一个[school]学年。

lines.en: I’m not concerned with that right now, though.
lines.zh: 不过我现在不关心这个。

lines.en: What I am concerned with is-
lines.zh: 我关心的是——

lines.en: : I want to let you know in advance that we will not be having sex this weekend.
lines.zh: : 我想提前告诉你，这个周末我们不会做爱。

lines.en: : Thank you for understanding.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你的理解。

lines.en: : I wonder if the bus has left yet.
lines.zh: : 不知道大巴开走了没有。

lines.en: scene makotobeachintro2
: You’ve been here for thirty seconds...Surely you’re able to go at least another several hours without getting an erection.
lines.zh: : 你才来了三十秒……你总该能再撑几个小时不勃起吧。

lines.en: : Ha. Funny joke, Makoto.
lines.zh: : 哈。真逗，Makoto。

lines.en: : Sensei, I’m being serious.
lines.zh: : 老师，我是认真的。

lines.en: : I feel like the only times I see you, I’m either taking your pants off or doing your paperwork.
lines.zh: : 我感觉每次见到你，我要么在脱你的裤子，要么在替你做文书工作。

lines.en: : I see no problem with this.
lines.zh: : 我看不出这有什么问题。

lines.en: : The {i}problem{/i} is that I want to actually relax tonight.
lines.zh: : {i}问题{/i}是我今晚想真正放松一下。

lines.en: : Are you implying that you don’t find sex relaxing, class rep?
lines.zh: : 你是在暗示你觉得做爱不放松吗，班长？

lines.en: scene makotobeachintro3
: I can assure you that having sex with someone of your size is anything but {i}relaxing{/i}, but that is beside the point.
lines.zh: : 我可以向你保证，跟你这种尺寸的人做爱绝对谈不上{i}放松{/i}，不过这不是重点。

lines.en: : The truth is that there’s something I’d like to discuss with you this weekend.
lines.zh: : 事实是，这个周末我有件事想跟你谈。

lines.en: : And we wouldn’t even be able to have sex anyway.
lines.zh: : 而且反正我们也没法做爱。

lines.en: : Why not?
lines.zh: : 为什么不能？

lines.en: : It’s complicated.
lines.zh: : 说来话长。

lines.en: : Girl problems?
lines.zh: : 女生的问题？

lines.en: : Sure. That’s one way to word it.
lines.zh: : 行，可以这么说。

lines.en: : You’ll see soon enough.
lines.zh: : 你很快就会知道的。

lines.en: : Wait, what?
lines.zh: : 等等，什么？

lines.en: scene makotobeachintro4
: Don’t worry about it.
lines.zh: : 别担心。

lines.en: : The fact is, you’re here with me now. And the last bus of the day just drove off while I had you distracted, so there is no longer an escape.
lines.zh: : 事实是，你现在跟我在一起了。而且趁我分散你注意力的时候，今天最后一班大巴刚开走，所以你逃不掉了。

lines.en: : You should have told me about this whole no sex thing before I came here.
lines.zh: : 你来之前就该跟我说清楚不做爱这回事。

lines.en: : You wouldn’t have come at all if I had done that.
lines.zh: : 我要是说了，你根本就不会来。

lines.en: : True. But look, I even made special preparations just for you.
lines.zh: : 说得对。可你看，我还专门为你做了特别准备。

lines.en: I empty out the contents of my suitcase onto the sand, showing Makoto how much I care about her.
lines.zh: 我把行李箱里的东西全倒在沙滩上，向 Makoto 展示我有多在乎她。

lines.en: scene makotobeachintro5
: Sensei...
lines.zh: : 老师……

lines.en: : Did...
lines.zh: : 你该不会……

lines.en: : Did you {i}only{/i} pack condoms for this trip?...
lines.zh: : 这趟旅行你{i}只{/i}带了避孕套吗？……

lines.en: : Anything for you, Makoto.
lines.zh: : 为了你什么都值得，Makoto。

lines.en: : Why are there only three of them, though?...
lines.zh: : 可为什么只有三个？……

lines.en: : I figured that you’d be so into it after the third condom that I could convince you to just keep going without one.
lines.zh: : 我琢磨着，用完第三个之后你会爽到不行，我就能说服你干脆不用接着来。

lines.en: scene makotobeachintro6
: I like to think I have a little more self-control than that.
lines.zh: : 我倒是觉得自己比那更有自制力一点。

lines.en: : Says the girl who basically blackmailed me into taking her virginity at a Halloween party.
lines.zh: : 这话可不像那个在万圣节派对上基本是勒索我、让我拿走她初夜的女孩说的。

lines.en: : Yeah, I did kind of do that.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我确实干过那种事。

lines.en: scene makotobeachintro7
: But that’s in the past! This weekend, I want to actually talk to you about something.
lines.zh: : 但那都是过去的事了！这个周末，我想真的跟你谈件事。

lines.en: : And we’re not going to be able to talk if our clothes are off.
lines.zh: : 而且衣服都脱了，我们就没法谈了。

lines.en: : I mean...we {i}could{/i}, but-
lines.zh: : 我是说……{i}也可以谈{/i}，不过——

lines.en: : No.
lines.zh: : 不行。

lines.en: : I want you to treat me like a human being this weekend. I let you push me around far too often.
lines.zh: : 这个周末我想让你把我当人看。我太常由着你摆布我了。

lines.en: : Wait, like the {i}whole{/i} weekend? Not just for an hour or two?
lines.zh: : 等等，{i}整个{/i}周末？不是一两个小时就行？

lines.en: : The whole weekend.
lines.zh: : 整个周末。

lines.en: : Or...I guess technically just until tomorrow, since we'll only be here for one night.
lines.zh: : 或者……严格说只到明天，因为我们只在这儿待一晚。

lines.en: : Ugh...
: Listen, I understand that you like to joke around, but there is only so much that I can take before it starts getting to me.
lines.zh: : 听着，我知道你喜欢开玩笑，但我的承受是有限度的，超过了我就会真的往心里去。

lines.en: scene makotobeachintro8

: So, with that out of the way, are you excited to spend some time with Makoto Miyamura not as your sex slave or class president, but as a girl who puts you on a much higher pedestal than you deserve?
lines.zh: : 那么，闲话说完，你期待和 Makoto Miyamura 共度一段时间吗——不是作为你的性奴或班长，而是作为一个把你捧到远高于你应得之处的女孩？

lines.en: I understand where Makoto’s coming from.
lines.zh: 我理解 Makoto 的出发点。

lines.en: I obviously know that I’ve been using her for my own personal gain, but why in the world would I {i}not{/i} do that when she’s made it so ridiculously easy?
lines.zh: 我当然知道我一直在为了私利利用她，可她把这事变得这么轻而易举，我到底有什么理由{i}不利用{/i}？

lines.en: I bet you’re thinking “because of common decency” or something along those lines, right?
lines.zh: 我猜你在想「因为基本的体面」之类的话，对吧？

lines.en: I’m sure that sort of thought process will take you very far in life.
lines.zh: 我确信这种思维方式能让你在人生中走得很远。

lines.en: Be sure to call and tell me all about it while you’re sulking in the darkest corner of your bedroom and I’m sitting on a throne of naked [teenager]s with a glass of white wine in my hand.
lines.zh: 等你窝在卧室最阴暗的角落里生闷气，而我坐在赤裸的[teenager]堆成的王座上、手里端着一杯白葡萄酒时，一定要打电话来跟我好好讲讲。

lines.en: And I don’t even like white wine.
lines.zh: 而我甚至不喜欢白葡萄酒。

lines.en: That’s how far apart you and I are.
lines.zh: 我们之间就差这么远。

lines.en: If something that I want is offered to me, I take it.
lines.zh: 如果我想要的东西被送到面前，我就拿。

lines.en: If something that I desire is within reach, I reach for it.
lines.zh: 如果我渴望的东西触手可及，我就伸手去够。

lines.en: You just wait and watch things drift further and further away.
lines.zh: 而你只是干等着，看着东西越飘越远。

lines.en: That’s no good at all.
lines.zh: 那可一点都不好。

lines.en: Sure, there’s also a chance that this is misplaced narration and that you, too, wrap your fingers around anything offered to you-
lines.zh: 当然，也有可能这段旁白放错了地方，其实你也一样，任何送到面前的东西都会一把攥住——

lines.en: Even when those things are dripping with so many negative connotations that it’s no different from gripping your own cock after putting it somewhere it doesn’t belong.
lines.zh: 哪怕那些东西滴着数不清的负面含义，跟把它放进了不该放的地方之后还握着自己那根鸡巴没什么两样。

lines.en: And if you are that person, then I like you.
lines.zh: 如果你就是这样的人，那我喜欢你。

lines.en: Hell, even if you {i}aren’t{/i} that person, I like you.
lines.zh: 妈的，就算你{i}不是{/i}那样的人，我也喜欢你。

lines.en: Just for this weekend, though.
lines.zh: 不过只在这个周末。

lines.en: Because even someone like me understands that you can only push a person so far before they can no longer give you anything.
lines.zh: 因为连我这样的人也明白，一个人被逼到极限之后，就再也给不了你任何东西了。

lines.en: And a relationship becomes meaningless once you have nothing to gain from it.
lines.zh: 而一旦你从一段关系里再也得不到任何好处，它就变得毫无意义。

lines.en: : Fine. I won’t take advantage of you this weekend.
lines.zh: : 好吧。这个周末我不占你便宜。

lines.en: : But you’re going to owe me.
lines.zh: : 但你会欠我的。

lines.en: scene makotobeachintro9
: Starting your marathon of niceties with a quid pro quo isn’t exactly the best first step, but I guess I’ll take what I can get.
lines.zh: : 用一句「你欠我的」来开启你的体贴马拉松，实在算不上最好的开场，不过我想能拿多少算多少吧。

lines.en: So will I.
lines.zh: 我也一样。

lines.en: scene makotobeachintro1
: Should we start heading to the inn, then?
lines.zh: : 那我们是不是该动身去旅馆了？

lines.en: : I already spoke with the front desk and secured a room. They just need your credit card information or they’re going to kick us out come dinner time.
lines.zh: : 我已经跟前台说过，订好了房间。他们只需要你的信用卡信息，不然到晚饭时间就会把我们赶出去。

lines.en: : Wait, you got the room already? I’m surprised they let you book it without putting any money down.
lines.zh: : 等等，你已经订好房间了？我很惊讶他们居然一分定金都没收就让你订了。

lines.en: : It’s not like many people visit this time of year, so I’m pretty sure they were willing to go above and beyond to accommodate us given the circumstances.
lines.zh: : 这个时节没什么人来，所以我很确定他们愿意在这种情况下格外通融地接待我们。

lines.en: : Also, it’s far too cold near the water to have just waited out here for you to arrive.
lines.zh: : 而且水边太冷了，我可不能就这么在外面等你来。

lines.en: : So, at the risk of being any {i}less{/i} direct, I will now say, “Sensei, please walk back to the inn with me before I freeze to death.”
lines.zh: : 所以，为了不再{i}拐弯抹角{/i}，我现在就直说：「老师，请陪我走回旅馆吧，不然我要冻死了。」

lines.en: : Fine, fine...
lines.zh: : 好好好……

lines.en: : Let’s go.
lines.zh: : 走吧。

lines.en: : Don’t come crying to me when you get horny and I’m not allowed to have sex with you, though.
lines.zh: : 不过等你发情了、而我又不能跟你做爱的时候，可别来找我哭。

lines.en: : Unlike you, I’m quite good at exhibiting self control.
lines.zh: : 不像你，我可是很会表现的——自制力方面。

lines.en: : Now, pick up your condoms and let’s get a move on.
lines.zh: : 现在，把你的避孕套捡起来，我们走吧。

lines.en: I look down at the sand and notice how the soft ocean breeze has managed to lightly bury the condoms I bought just for tonight.
lines.zh: 我低头看向沙滩，发现柔和的海风已经把我专为今晚买的避孕套轻轻埋了起来。

lines.en: scene makotobeachintro9
: Uhh...
: Why are you just staring at them?...
lines.zh: : 你为什么只是盯着它们看？……

lines.en: : Because they’re already gone, Makoto.
lines.zh: : 因为它们已经没了，Makoto。

lines.en: : Gone like condoms in the sand.
lines.zh: : 就像沙里的避孕套一样，没了。

lines.en: : I think you’re looking for the phrase, “Dust in the wind.”
lines.zh: : 我觉得你想说的那句话是「风中之尘」吧。

lines.en: scene black
: And now you’re just walking away like you said something really cool.
lines.zh: : 现在你就这么走了，好像自己说了句特别酷的话似的。

lines.en: I gaze up at the sky.
lines.zh: 我抬头望向天空。

lines.en: It looks like it’s about to rain.
lines.zh: 看起来要下雨了。

lines.en: A large wave crashes against the beach.
lines.zh: 一个大浪拍上沙滩。

lines.en: And comes to steal away the condoms in the sand...
lines.zh: 前来把沙里的避孕套偷走……

lines.en: scene makotobeachintro10
: Wow. You’re, uhh...really not handling this abstinent weekend plan well, are you?
lines.zh: : 哇。你，呃……对这个禁欲周末计划适应得真差，是吧？

lines.en: : I’ll be fine. The idea of a vacation without sex seems strange to me, though.
lines.zh: : 我会没事的。不过对我来说，一个没有性的假期这想法本身就挺怪。

lines.en: : If it’s any consolation, it’s much less of me not wanting to and a whole lot of us just...not being able to.
lines.zh: : 如果这能让你好受点的话，与其说是我不想，不如说基本上是我们……根本做不到。

lines.en: : Right. Because of girl problems.
lines.zh: : 对。因为女生的问题。

lines.en: : Something like that.
lines.zh: : 差不多是这样。

lines.en: : But even if we were to do those sorts of things together, it wouldn’t change how I’d still see this as the perfect opportunity for you to be nice to me for once.
lines.zh: : 但就算我们一起做了那些事，也改变不了这一点——我依然把这看作让你难得对我好一次的绝佳机会。

lines.en: : It’s rather bothersome watching you treat Ami like an angel and leaving {i}me{/i}, Makoto Miyamura, like I’m some sort of-
lines.zh: : 看着你把 Ami 当天使一样对待，却把 Makoto Miyamura {i}我{/i}丢在一边，好像我是某种——

lines.en: scene makotobeachintro11
: Condom in the sand?
lines.zh: : 沙里的避孕套？

lines.en: : Can you please stop saying that? It’s one of the worst analogies I’ve ever heard.
lines.zh: : 你能不能别再这么说了？这是我听过最烂的比喻之一。

lines.en: : Oh, come on. It’s not {i}that{/i} bad.
lines.zh: : 哦，拜托。没{i}那么{/i}糟吧。

lines.en: : Fine. Maybe it’s not the worst, but it’s still unsuitable as a description for our...strange dynamic with one another.
lines.zh: : 好吧。也许不是最烂的，但它依然不适合用来形容我们之间那种……奇怪的关系。

lines.en: scene makotobeachintro12
: It {i}is{/i} kind of strange, isn’t it?
lines.zh: : {i}确实{/i}挺奇怪的，不是吗？

lines.en: : If I were you, I would have stopped doing my bidding a long time ago.
lines.zh: : 如果我是你，早就不再听我使唤了。

lines.en: : What’s the point of keeping it up if you’re not enjoying it?
lines.zh: : 既然你并不享受，那还继续下去有什么意义？

lines.en: : Hope, I suppose.
lines.zh: : 大概是希望吧。

lines.en: : Hope that one day you’ll realize how harsh you've been...and start treating me with the respect I deserve rather than the respect you can be bothered to hand out.
lines.zh: : 希望有一天你会意识到自己有多苛刻……然后开始用我应得的尊重对待我，而不是你乐意施舍的那点尊重。

lines.en: scene makotobeachintro13
: I really shouldn’t...but I look up to you a lot, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 我真的不该……但我很仰慕你，老师。

lines.en: : But I don’t want to keep looking up because that means you’ll always be looking down.
lines.zh: : 可我不想一直仰视，因为那意味着你会一直俯视我。

lines.en: : And if we’re not on equal footing, neither of us will ever {i}really{/i} be happy.
lines.zh: : 如果我们不站在平等的位置上，我们俩就永远都不会{i}真的{/i}快乐。

lines.en: : Are you not happy, Makoto?
lines.zh: : 你不快乐吗，Makoto？

lines.en: scene makotobeachintro14
: I’m fine.
lines.zh: : 我没事。

lines.en: : Just not very good at explaining myself, apparently.
lines.zh: : 只是显然不太会表达自己。

lines.en: : But I have an entire weekend to do that, so...
lines.zh: : 不过我有一整个周末可以做到，所以……

lines.en: : I hope you don’t mind me being extremely intrusive and making the most of the short time we have left together.
lines.zh: : 我希望你不介意我极度冒昧，好好利用我们剩下的短暂时光。

lines.en: scene black
She says, as if she’s dying.
lines.zh: 她说得好像自己快死了一样。

lines.en: We’re all dying, though.
lines.zh: 不过我们都在死。

lines.en: It’s not just her.
lines.zh: 不只是她。

lines.en: We make it to the inn and I accompany Makoto to the front desk.
lines.zh: 我们到了旅馆，我陪 Makoto 走到前台。

lines.en: There’s apparently a discount on rooms due to this being the offseason, and it’s actually a pretty good deal for the type of place this is.
lines.zh: 因为是淡季，房费似乎有折扣，以这种档次的地方来说，其实相当划算。

lines.en: So good that I probably wouldn’t even mind coming back before summer starts, which is saying a lot given my tendency to pinch pennies.
lines.zh: 好到我在夏天到来之前再来一次大概也不介意——考虑到我一向爱抠门，这已经很能说明问题了。

lines.en: Regardless, I pay the clerk and Makoto points me in the direction of our room, tugging on my sleeve to get me to follow her.
lines.zh: 不管怎样，我付了钱给店员，Makoto 给我指了房间的方向，拽着我的袖子让我跟上她。

lines.en: I oblige.
lines.zh: 我从命了。

lines.en: And our weekend of...apparently no debauchery at all finally begins.
lines.zh: 而我们那个……显然一点放荡都没有的周末，终于开始了。

$ makoto_love += 1
{i}Makoto’s affection has increased to [makoto_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Makoto 的好感度提升到了 [makoto_love]！{/i}
